selection: buy_review; full factor coverage; no critical, conditional or negative operating profit; exact factor profile within model family
schedule: first forward snapshot of each Gregorian month; selections never revised within that month
execution_reference: first independently observed market session strictly after the actual decision date in Tehran; official unadjusted weighted closing price
calendar: Saturday through Wednesday; at least 30 frozen-universe securities with positive traded volume
corporate_actions: unexplained yesterday-price/previous-close discontinuity blocks price returns; no invented adjustment or dividend
benchmark: equal weight of the same frozen complete-factor universe, including low ranks; not a market index
limitations: Reference performance is hypothetical. Queue priority, executable bid/ask, slippage, taxes, corporate actions and actual fills are not certified. Cost is an experimental assumption, not a broker tariff. No brokerage connection or live orders.
